terms.s1Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: FreeLingo is an open-source AI-powered language learning platform available in two modes: (1) self-hosted, where you run it on your own infrastructure at no cost, and (2) as a hosted service operated by the FreeLingo team with a free plan and paid subscriptions. By using this service in either mode, you agree to these Terms of Service.
terms.s2Intro: __TODO-REVIEW__: You may use FreeLingo solely for personal language learning purposes. You agree not to:
terms.s2i1: __TODO-REVIEW__: Attempt to gain unauthorized access to any part of the system.
terms.s2i2: __TODO-REVIEW__: Upload malicious content or attempt to disrupt the service.
terms.s2i3: __TODO-REVIEW__: Share your account credentials with third parties.
terms.s2i4: __TODO-REVIEW__: Use automated scripts or bots to abuse the AI tutoring features.
terms.s3Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: You must be at least 16 years old to create an account and use FreeLingo. By registering, you confirm that you meet this age requirement. If we become aware that an account belongs to a person under 16, we will delete it and all associated data without notice. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your credentials and for all activity under your account. The operator of the instance — yourself for self-hosted deployments, or the FreeLingo team for the hosted service — may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these terms.
terms.s4Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: Conversations with the AI tutor are stored in the database for learning continuity. In the hosted service, AI chat and voice features are processed via OpenAI's API and your content is subject to OpenAI's usage policies. The AI may produce inaccurate responses — always apply your own judgement. FreeLingo is not responsible for content generated by underlying language models. The content generated by the AI tutor (exercises, corrections, explanations, and other materials) belongs to you for your personal use. FreeLingo does not claim ownership over your conversations or the content generated from them.
terms.s5Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: Self-hosted deployments are free and the operator retains full control over their data and infrastructure. The hosted service operated by the FreeLingo team offers a free plan with usage limits and paid subscriptions for unlimited access, available on a monthly or yearly basis. The free plan includes a 7-day full-access trial (no payment method required) and thereafter limited daily quotas for lessons and AI chat, plus weekly quotas for listening exercises, reading exercises, and voice conversations. Paid subscriptions remove all usage limits on these features. In the hosted service your data is stored on servers operated by the FreeLingo team. Current usage limits for your account are available on your dashboard.
terms.s6Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: The free plan provides limited access to AI features with a 7-day full-access trial for new users (no payment method required). Paid subscriptions are available monthly or yearly and renew automatically unless cancelled beforehand. You may cancel from Settings at any time, effective at the end of the current period. The operator may also cancel renewals or subscriptions if the service is changed or closed. If the service ends before a paid period finishes, any refund required by consumer law will apply. Withdrawal rights and applicable prices are displayed and handled in accordance with current law.
terms.s7Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: The hosted service is provided without continuity or availability guarantees. The operator may change, suspend, or close it at any time for technical, financial, or any other reasons. Where reasonably possible, planned closures will be announced through the application or by email. After the announced date, accounts and operational data may be deleted without recovery. FreeLingo does not provide a backup service or an automated export tool.
terms.s8Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: FreeLingo and its contributors are not liable for any direct, indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from your use of, or inability to use, this service. To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you in the three months preceding the claim. You agree to indemnify and hold harmless FreeLingo and its contributors from any third-party claims, damages, or expenses arising from your use of the service in violation of these terms.
terms.s9Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: These terms are governed by the laws of Spain. Any disputes arising from these terms shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Spain, unless mandatory consumer protection law in your country of residence provides otherwise.
terms.s10Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: These terms may be updated at any time. Material changes will be communicated through the service interface or by email when appropriate. Continued use after a change constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
terms.s11Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: If any provision of these terms is found to be invalid or unenforceable by a court of competent jurisdiction, that provision will be limited or eliminated to the minimum extent necessary and the remaining provisions will remain in full force and effect.
terms.linkContact: __TODO-REVIEW__: For questions about these terms, use the contact form at freelingo.app while available or the contact channel published in the FreeLingo GitHub repository.

privacy.s1Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: FreeLingo is available as a self-hosted application and as a hosted service. For self-hosted deployments, all data is stored exclusively on the operator's server and the FreeLingo project authors have no access to it. For the hosted service, the FreeLingo team acts as the data controller and this policy describes how your personal data is collected, used, and protected.
privacy.s2Intro: __TODO-REVIEW__: FreeLingo is not directed at children under 16. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 16 years of age. If you are under 16, do not create an account or provide any personal data. When you create an account and use FreeLingo, the following data is stored:
privacy.s2i1: __TODO-REVIEW__: Username, display name, and email address.
privacy.s2i2: __TODO-REVIEW__: Hashed password (bcrypt — your plain-text password is never stored).
privacy.s2i3: __TODO-REVIEW__: Native language preference and learning settings.
privacy.s2i5: __TODO-REVIEW__: Chat and conversation history with the AI tutor.
privacy.s2i6: __TODO-REVIEW__: Flashcard decks, study progress, and spaced-repetition data.
privacy.s2i8: __TODO-REVIEW__: Subscription status, plan type, and Stripe customer identifier (for paid service subscribers).
privacy.s2i9: __TODO-REVIEW__: Global account memories and preferences that the AI tutor learns during conversations or that you add manually to personalize future interactions across learning languages.
privacy.s2i10: __TODO-REVIEW__: Feature requests, bug reports, comments, and votes you submit through the feedback board. Only your username is shown publicly; all users can see published suggestions and reports.
privacy.s3Intro: __TODO-REVIEW__: Your data is used exclusively to provide the FreeLingo learning experience:
privacy.s3i1: __TODO-REVIEW__: Authenticating you and maintaining your session.
privacy.s3i2: __TODO-REVIEW__: Personalizing your study plan and tutor interactions.
privacy.s3i3: __TODO-REVIEW__: Tracking your learning progress over time.
privacy.s3i5: __TODO-REVIEW__: Remembering your preferences and context so the AI tutor can offer you more personalized interactions.
privacy.s3i6: __TODO-REVIEW__: Displaying and managing community feature requests and bug reports.
privacy.s3Footer: __TODO-REVIEW__: Your data is never sold, rented, or shared with third-party marketing services.
privacy.s4Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: In the hosted service, AI chat, voice synthesis (TTS), and voice transcription (STT) are provided via OpenAI's API. Your conversation content and audio are sent to OpenAI for processing, subject to OpenAI's Privacy Policy (openai.com/privacy). Payment processing is handled by Stripe, Inc. (USA); Stripe processes payment data directly and we do not store payment card details on our servers — your transaction data is subject to Stripe's Privacy Policy (stripe.com/privacy). For self-hosted deployments, the operator chooses the AI provider; by default a local Ollama instance is used and no data leaves the server.
privacy.s5Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: FreeLingo uses two technical cookies strictly necessary for the service to function: a refresh_token (httpOnly, 30-day expiry) used for session authentication, and NEXT_LOCALE (1-year expiry) to remember your language preference. No tracking or advertising cookies are used. For anonymous traffic measurement, we use Umami — a self-hosted, open-source analytics tool that does not use cookies, collects no personal data, and keeps all data on our servers.
privacy.s6Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: If you are in the European Economic Area, you have the GDPR rights of access, correction, deletion, objection, and data portability. You can delete your account directly from Settings. Other requests are handled manually through the contact in section 8; FreeLingo does not provide an automated export tool. We process data to provide the service (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). OpenAI and Stripe may process data in the USA under the safeguards applicable to international transfers. You may complain to the Spanish Data Protection Authority (aepd.es) or your local supervisory authority.
privacy.s7Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: Operational data is kept while your account exists and the hosted service remains active. You can delete memories, languages, or your entire account from Settings. The operator may also delete all accounts and their data when closing the service, after whatever reasonable notice is possible. Deletion cannot be undone. After deleting the systems and copies under the operator's control, FreeLingo will not retain personal data. Stripe may retain payment and transaction information under its own policy and legal obligations.
privacy.s8Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: For hosted-service privacy questions, use the contact form at freelingo.app while available. After closure, use the contact channel published in the FreeLingo GitHub repository and do not post personal data in public issues. For self-hosted deployments, contact that instance's administrator.
privacy.s9Body: __TODO-REVIEW__: If any provision of this policy is found to be invalid or unenforceable, that provision will be limited to the minimum extent necessary and the remaining provisions will remain in full force and effect.

faq.title: __TODO-REVIEW__: FAQ
faq.subtitle: __TODO-REVIEW__: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a_start: __TODO-REVIEW__: Start with the Assessment. It detects your English level (A1–C2) and your strengths and weaknesses. With that result you can generate a personalized Study Plan that fills your Dashboard with daily lessons. Without the Assessment, the Dashboard is empty.
faq.workflowStep1: __TODO-REVIEW__: Register and select your native language
faq.workflowStep2: __TODO-REVIEW__: Take the Assessment → your CEFR level is detected
faq.workflowStep3: __TODO-REVIEW__: Generate your Study Plan from the Dashboard
faq.workflowStep4: __TODO-REVIEW__: Complete your daily lessons (START button in the Dashboard)
faq.workflowStep5: __TODO-REVIEW__: Use Flashcards to train vocabulary in parallel
faq.workflowStep6: __TODO-REVIEW__: Practice free conversation with the AI Tutor
faq.a_language: __TODO-REVIEW__: FreeLingo currently supports several languages (American English, British English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Mainland Chinese, Portuguese, Spanish), and we will keep adding more over time. When a new language becomes available, you will find it in Settings → My Languages — add it and start learning right away.
faq.a_assessment: __TODO-REVIEW__: A 15-question AI-generated test covering grammar, vocabulary, reading comprehension, and sentence transformation, with difficulty ranging from A1 to C1. When you finish, you get your CEFR level, a score, and an analysis of your strengths and weaknesses. This result feeds into the Study Plan and generated Flashcards.
faq.q_studyPlan: __TODO-REVIEW__: What is the Study Plan and how do I generate one?
faq.a_studyPlan: __TODO-REVIEW__: After the Assessment, go to the Dashboard and click Generate Study Plan. A week-by-week plan with daily lessons tailored to your CEFR level and goals will be created automatically. Each lesson includes multiple-choice and free-writing exercises evaluated by AI.
faq.a_resources: __TODO-REVIEW__: The Resources section brings together reference material that is independent from your Study Plan: grammar by level, vocabulary sets, and useful phrases. You can use it anytime to review, look up explanations, or expand your vocabulary without waiting for a daily lesson.
faq.a_flashcards: __TODO-REVIEW__: A vocabulary training system using the SM-2 spaced repetition algorithm. Generate cards on any topic (e.g. "business", "phrasal verbs", "food") with a definition, example sentence, and translation into your native language. The system calculates when to show each card again just before you forget it. Completely independent from the Study Plan.
faq.q_vocabulary: __TODO-REVIEW__: How do I add words to my vocabulary?
faq.a_vocabulary: __TODO-REVIEW__: You can save words in two ways: (1) While reading a lesson, listening exercise, or chatting with the tutor, highlight any word with your mouse and click Save in the tooltip that appears — the AI will generate a definition, example sentence, and translation into your native language. (2) Go to Vocabulary, open a vocabulary set for your level, and click Add All to import the whole set at once. Your saved words appear in My Vocabulary under the Flashcards section.
faq.q_tutor: __TODO-REVIEW__: How does the AI Tutor work?
faq.a_tutor: __TODO-REVIEW__: A free-form streaming chat. The tutor knows your CEFR level and weak points to tailor its responses. Ask grammar questions, request explanations, practice writing in English, or just have a conversation. Conversations are saved and accessible from the sidebar across sessions.
faq.q_voice: __TODO-REVIEW__: How does the voice conversation work?
faq.a_voice: __TODO-REVIEW__: The Voice Conversation mode lets you speak with the AI tutor in real time. Press Start to begin — the app listens for your voice automatically using voice activity detection (VAD) and the tutor replies with synthesised speech. You can interrupt the tutor at any moment (barge-in). The session ends when you reach the time limit or press Stop. Make sure your browser has microphone permission enabled.
faq.a_listening: __TODO-REVIEW__: The Listening section generates short audio passages at your CEFR level, voiced by AI. Listen to the audio, then answer 5 comprehension questions. After submitting, you get your score (0–5), XP, correct answers, and the full transcript. You can generate new exercises on demand.
faq.a_reading: __TODO-REVIEW__: The Reading section generates texts at your CEFR level — notices, emails, articles, blog posts, and more. Read the passage and answer 5 multiple-choice questions. After submitting, you get your score (0–5) and XP. New exercises can be generated on demand.
faq.q_providers: __TODO-REVIEW__: Which AI providers does FreeLingo support?
faq.provider_ollama: __TODO-REVIEW__: Local, free. Requires Ollama running on the host. Recommended model: gemma4:e4b. May be slow without a GPU.
faq.provider_openai: __TODO-REVIEW__: OpenAI API (GPT-4o, etc.). Fast and reliable. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY.
faq.a_invite: __TODO-REVIEW__: Yes. From Admin → Users the admin can create users directly or generate single-use invite links that expire in 48 hours. Public registration is disabled by default (ALLOW_REGISTRATION=false).
faq.q_password: __TODO-REVIEW__: How do I change my password or native language?
faq.a_password: __TODO-REVIEW__: Go to <settingsLink>Settings</settingsLink>. You can update your display name, native language, and password from there.
faq.q_uiLanguage: __TODO-REVIEW__: How do I change the platform language?
faq.a_uiLanguage: __TODO-REVIEW__: Go to Settings and find the Platform language dropdown in the Profile section. Select your preferred language and the entire interface will switch immediately.
faq.q_feedback: __TODO-REVIEW__: How do I suggest a new feature or report a bug?
faq.a_feedback: __TODO-REVIEW__: Use the <feedbackLink>Feedback</feedbackLink> section in the sidebar. You can create suggestions for new features or report bugs. Vote on other users' ideas, leave comments, and track the status of each request. All submissions are public and are reviewed by the admin.
